trackDescriptionDetailPage: For the Stellar Stories track, we wanted to give an opportunity to creatives to express themselves with a dedicated track. In this track, we want you to explore the topic of data and cultural preservation using technology and design a solution that could help resolve this. As we continue to progress into the future, the preservation of data and cultural items is crucial for current and future generations to learn, understand and appreciate our history. This track aims to provide participants with an opportunity to experiment with new UIs and design solutions to help preserve data and culture. Recommended for beginner coders or those with a good understanding of UI/UX principles.
